basic_task.description: Standard engineering task with mandatory project methods and agent defaults

example.description:
### 📋 Objective & Scope
Implement the feature module adhering to project methods and agent standards.

### 🏗️ Mandatory Engineering Methods & Architecture
- **Dynamic i18n Standard**: All text strings must use `useI18n()`. Single active language at a time (`en`, `gu`, `hi`, `mr`, `ta`, `te`, `kn`, `bn`). Zero hardcoded static or bilingual strings. Synced to Header Language Switcher.
- **Drawer Policy**: Right Slide-Over Drawer (`Drawer` / `AppDrawer`), zero centered popups.
- **Tenant Isolation**: Explicit `x-company-id: <UUID>` header scoping.

### 📝 Step-by-Step Implementation Sub-tasks
1. Define module localization keys in `src/lib/translations/*.ts`.
2. Implement component views and right slide-over drawer.
3. Verify reactivity when changing header language.

### ✅ Acceptance Criteria & Definition of Done
- [ ] 0 hardcoded strings or bilingual combinations in JSX/TSX.
- [ ] UI strictly renders in single selected language.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes with 0 errors.
